catalogue: Robbins Lunar Crater Database (2018) PDS4 Bundle
great_circle_formula: d = R * arccos(sin(lat1)*sin(lat2) + cos(lat1)*cos(lat2)*cos(lon1 - lon2)), R = 1737.4 km

south_pole_targets.name: Shackleton Crater
south_pole_targets.features: Permanently Shadowed Region (PSR), cold trap, hydrogen enrichment detected on rim

south_pole_targets.name: de Gerlache Crater
south_pole_targets.features: High illuminated rim peaks, steep interior slope

south_pole_targets.name: Faustini Crater
south_pole_targets.features: Deep cryo-temperatures recorded by Diviner, candidate volatile storage

south_pole_targets.name: Shoemaker Crater
south_pole_targets.features: Strong LEND epithermal neutron count suppression

south_pole_targets.name: Nobile Crater
south_pole_targets.features: VIPER rover target site, rolling terrain on ridge

mid_lat_targets.name: Aristillus Crater
mid_lat_targets.features: Prominent ray system, high rock abundance, prominent nighttime thermal anomaly in GHRM

mid_lat_targets.name: Autolycus Crater
mid_lat_targets.features: Fresh circular rim, blocky ejecta blanket, well characterized in Diviner GDR

mid_lat_targets.name: Archimedes Crater
mid_lat_targets.features: Smooth mare-flooded floor, low rock abundance in interior, rocky exterior rim

mid_lat_targets.name: Spitzbergen Montes Peak
mid_lat_targets.features: Isolated mountain chain remnant in Mare Imbrium with steep slopes
